title: Beyond Construction: The Platform Effect of Environmental Infrastructure in Carbon Capture and Storage
summary: The paper presents a replicable, multi-scalar IMPLAN-based framework to analyse the economic effects of a proposed CCS facility in a U.S. Gulf Coast county with a deep-water port. It separately examines sequestration field construction, pipeline system development, annual operations and on-site capture installations, and assesses impacts at local, regional and state level.
why_it_matters: Splitting regional economic effects by chain component (pipeline, storage field, capture, operations) offers a template for valuing port-based CCS hub infrastructure beyond the construction phase.
